newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX ASKS COURT TO HALT OUTOKUMPU PATENT.
newsitem.headline: LAROX ASKS COURT TO HALT OUTOKUMPU PATENT.

text.p: Finnish industrial filters maker Larox Oy said on Monday it had asked a Helsinki court to annul a patent granted to Finnish mining and minerals group Outokumpu Oy .
The suit against Outokumpu is a continuation of Larox's rebuttal of an Outokumpu suit against it for infringement of patent No. FI-76639, Larox said.

The dispute, which began last year, concerns a measurement method that can be used in combination with Larox filters to weigh filtered substances, Larox's corporate legal advisor Juha Parkkila told Reuters.
"We have delivered just one filter with this system in Finland ... and several abroad," Parkkila said, adding that the disputed technology generated only a "small part" of net sales.
"It is not an essential part of our filters. It is an accessory that is offered to customers," Larox vice president Katariina Aaltonen said.
